effect: The caster is briefly replaced by an exact duplicate who immediately tries to cast the same spell before vanishing mid-incantation.
Every light source within 60ft extinguishes simultaneously. They reignite one by one over the next minute, each a different colour.
The caster speaks only in rhyme for 1 hour. Every rhyme is unintentionally accurate about someone present.
A miniature sun appears above the caster's head for 10 minutes, shedding bright light in a 10ft radius. It hums the Division of Lumination's anthem quietly and without stopping.
The caster's shadow detaches and sprints away. It returns at dawn, slightly out of breath.
All metal objects within 30ft become uncomfortably warm to the touch for 1 hour. Not damaging. Just uncomfortable.
The target of the spell is wreathed in silver moonlight for 1 minute. Undead in the area treat them as if they were consecrated ground.
The caster ages 1d10 years. At the next long rest, they de-age the same amount. The intervening time counts for nothing.
Every creature within 30ft simultaneously sneezes. Only the caster knows why.
The sky (or ceiling) above the caster briefly displays the phase of the moon as it should appear, regardless of time of day or what the Division of Lumination says it should be.
The caster's voice becomes an echo of itself for 1 hour — every word repeated once, one second later, slightly quieter.
A random nearby object floats 3 feet off the ground for 1 minute, rotating slowly as if being examined by an invisible hand.
The spell slot is consumed but the spell is not cast. Instead, a single perfect flower appears in the caster's hand.
All doors and windows within 60ft slam open simultaneously. Any that were already open slam shut.
The caster becomes invisible — but only to themselves. Everyone else can still see them perfectly clearly.
An enormous spectral eye opens in the air above the caster, stares directly at them for 6 seconds, then closes and vanishes.
The caster gains the ability to speak with insects for 1 hour. The insects have strong, divisive opinions about local politics.
Gravity reverses for the caster only for 3 seconds. Just long enough to be embarrassing.
The spell fires correctly, then fires again from a random point within 30ft targeting a random creature. The caster has no idea this will happen.
Every written word within 60ft rearranges itself into a different language for 1 minute. The meaning is preserved. The panic is not.
A bell tolls — loud, clear, sourceless — once for each creature currently dying within one mile. No one knows why they know what it means.
The caster's hair (or equivalent) turns a deep lunar silver permanently. DOL officials will notice.
The caster and the nearest creature swap positions instantly. Spells in transit continue to their original trajectories.
The caster emits blinding light equivalent to a Daylight spell centred on themselves for 1 round. Allies included.
For 1 minute, any lie spoken within 30ft of the caster manifests as a visible puff of acrid black smoke from the liar's mouth.
The ground within 10ft of the caster becomes covered in dense, soft moss. It remains permanently.
The caster is polymorphed into a cat for exactly 1 minute. They retain their mental stats. They retain full memory of the experience.
All coin within 60ft flips to its opposite face simultaneously. No wealth is gained or lost. It is simply noticed.
The caster's spell affects a secondary random target at half potency. The secondary target is chosen with unerring dramatic irony.
A bureaucratic document appears in the caster's hands: a formal complaint, filed in triplicate, objecting to the use of magic in this location. It is signed by someone nearby.
The caster is surrounded by an aura of profound, sourceless sadness for 1 hour. They feel fine. Everyone within 10ft does not.
The caster speaks the true name of an entity they have never heard of. They instantly forget it. A nearby gemstone cracks.
Any creature that was unconscious within 60ft during the past minute regains 1 hit point and wakes up, bewildered.
The temperature drops 30 degrees in a 60ft radius for 1 minute. The caster feels nothing. Everyone else is acutely aware of the change.
The caster becomes magnetic for 1 hour. Metal objects slowly drift toward them. This is mildly inconvenient until it is catastrophically inconvenient.
The spell is cast perfectly. Additionally, the caster's left hand briefly phases through solid matter. Just the left. Just once.
A second moon appears in the sky for 1d4 hours, visible to all. DOL heralds begin issuing contradictory official statements within the day.
All creatures within 30ft forget the last 6 seconds of their lives and repeat their actions, confused. The caster remembers both versions.
The caster's eyes glow a deep violet for 24 hours. Undead avoid their gaze. Children find it delightful.
A sound like distant, beautiful singing resonates from the earth beneath the caster's feet. Echo Vein resonance. It stops when the caster moves.
Every cantrip the caster attempts for the next hour casts at double the effect and has a 50% chance of targeting the wrong creature.
The caster is briefly aware of every living thing within 1 mile — not their thoughts, just their presence, weight, and warmth. The sensation lasts 4 seconds and leaves the caster unsettled.
A random creature within 60ft becomes the subject of a detailed prophecy, spoken aloud by the caster in a voice that is not their own. The caster has no memory of the words afterward.
All food and drink within 60ft becomes slightly, inexplicably more delicious. The effect is non-magical and permanent.
The caster's spell slot is refunded but the spell's effect is delayed by exactly 10 minutes. The caster knows this. The target does not.
A small rift tears open nearby and deposits a single, confused pigeon before sealing. The pigeon is entirely ordinary. It has seen things.
All shadows within 60ft point in the same direction regardless of light sources for 1 minute. The direction is toward something important. No one realises in time.
The caster emits a pulse of force that shoves every creature within 10ft 5 feet away. The caster is not moved. They feel a strange proprietary satisfaction about this.
For 1 hour, the caster heals 1 HP each time they make someone genuinely laugh. They become disturbingly motivated.
The caster's next spell slot expended today is treated as two levels higher. The next day, one additional spell slot of any level is lost permanently until they complete a greater restoration ritual.
